description: An HTML file that implements the front-end interface for a database visualizer application. It includes structural markup, CSS styling, and embedded JavaScript code to load, display, and interact with database tables and data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the server and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the view.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database item to show or hide tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and inserts the HTML table to display data records.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell contents with special handling for objects, nulls, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full or truncated content when clicked.
